items.title: Nancy Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Sy Zentner, when I was working some of the night clubs, had a band that was one of the best bands that you would ever want to find in a club. So I’ve been blessed that I was able to work with big bands a lot longer than most people

ctx.x: The Rich band was quite young.

Yes they were. But on it. I mean they could read from across the room. They were really happening. It was a dynamite band. Sy Zentner, when I was working some of the night clubs, had a band that was one of the best bands that you would ever want to find in a club. So I’ve been blessed that I was able to work with big bands a lot longer than most people because I was playing the supper clubs. And they had the Freddy Martin band and I can’t remember the name of the band, a fabulous orchestra in San Francisco at the…
Did you ever have occasion when someone would write charts for you and did you have opportunities to say, “This isn’t working, can you fix that?”
